questions.question:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error. 

The Public Works Department has propose to construct an elevated corridor which will run parallel to the National highway.

options.text: The Public Works Department has propose

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. The Public Works Department has proposed.**

 
• The given sentence is in **present perfect tense** and in present perfect tense** third form of verb** is used.
 
• Hence, **'proposed'** will be used in place of 'propose'.
 
• So, the correct sentence will be: **The Public Works Department has proposed to construct an elevated corridor which will run parallel to the National highway.**

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence. 

The gardener has mowed the lawn.

options.text: The lawn has been mowed by the gardener.
The gardener has been mowed by the lawn.
The lawn is mowed by the gardener.
The lawn was mowed by the gardener.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. the lawn has been mowed by the gardener.**

 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense** and while making the passive voice of perfect tenses,** 'been'** is used.
 
• While making the passive voice the object of the sentence is made the subject and vice versa. 
 
• All these conditions are satisfied by option 1) and it will be the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence. 

Mrs. Gupta said to me, "Why are these boys standing in the sun?"

options.text: Mrs. Gupta asked me why those boys were standing in the sun.
Mrs. Gupta said to me that why are these boys standing in the sun.
Mrs. Gupta asked me why were these boys standing in the sun.
Mrs. Gupta told me why those boys are standing in the sun.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is Option 1.**

 
• Since this is an interrogative sentence, 'said to' will be converted into asked.
 
• present tense will be converted into past tense and interrogative sentence will be converted into assertive sentence.
 
• And 'these' will be converted into 'those'. 
 
• All these conditions are satisfied in the option 1), hence, it is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order. 

A. Most of them are in jail because of their circumstances.

B. Not all prisoners are hardcore criminals.

C. So, they deserve a chance to rehabilitate themselves.

D. Therefore, learning a trade would help them reintegrate with society.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 4** in which the sentences are arranged in a correct sequence. 
 
• The sentence after rearrangement is 'Not all prisoners are hardcore criminals most of them are in jail because of their circumstances. So, they deserve a chance to rehabilitate themselves. Therefore, learning a trade would help them reintegrate with society'.
